messages.body: Morning. The script sent both three-month emails again: one for contract expiry, one for yearly expiry. The weekly recap is in the same inbox. Let's use this thread for the April renewals and the next annual budget lines.
Zahle community centre, RENT-ZAH-03: contract ends April 16. Our follow-up is set for March 26 in the Sheet. USD 14,400/year, FA-2026.
Is the April date from the contract or from the sheet?
Signed contract. I have the scan open.
Jbeil health centre, RENT-JBE-04, still has last April in the yearly end column. It was renewed and nobody rolled that cell forward. USD 18,600/year.
Halba store RENT-HAL-02 is worse, all 3 date cells blank. It's in the recap but there's nothing for the script to count from.
Just got home. Tripoli traffic was something else today.
Le 26 mars ne colle pas. Pour Zahlé, on remonte de trois mois à partir de la fin du contrat, pas de la fin de la période annuelle.
You're right. The March 26 follow-up was copied from another row. Corrected it in the Sheet to January 16, three months before April 16. That's the date we'll follow up.
I'll handle the Zahle follow-up myself. I have the lease and the last rent note here.
For the next annual period on the Tripoli warehouse, let's charge the whole USD 21,600 to EA-2026. The draft has room there.
تمام، موافقة نحط إيجار المستودع كله على هالبند.
We could give the weekly recap its own tab with a chart of rents by town.
Got the signed page from Tripoli. RENT-TRI-07 expires April 24. The yearly and contract end dates are the same on that one.
Finance needs the consolidated renewal budget pack next Monday.
@Karim Nahle can you put the property lines and reserve amounts together?
Yep, I'll own the budget pack. The rent column is yearly, that saves me one pass.
Could we move the pack to Wednesday instead? Gives everyone a little breathing room.
Wednesday won't work for finance. Keep Monday for now.
I'll upload the signed Tripoli notice scan tomorrow end of day. It was in the paper folder all along.
@Dalia Akl can you draft a bilingual reminder template for the site admins?
Power cut again. The generator is running but my wifi apparently didnt get the memo.
Do we have to include service charges in the Tripoli rent line?
No, separate line on the lease. Also the signed notice scan is in the Tripoli folder now.
The reserve figures are still locked. Finance moved the budget pack to Thursday.
Fine by me. I'll keep filling the lines I have.
Spoke to the Zahle owner today about renewal. He says the rent is staying the same.
Saida owner still hasn't replied to the frist note btw. Nothing in the inbox.
On my second coffee and it is doing absolutely nothing.
Found the signed Jbeil renewal. The yearly period ends April 30 this year. I rolled the stale cell forward. The contract itself runs beyond that.
For rows with no dates, let's keep the automatic emails off and show the rows under Missing dates in the weekly recap.
D’accord, on garde les lignes sans date dans le récapitulatif.
مين معه نسخة عن محضر تسليم المخزن بحلبا؟
Baalbek health centre is RENT-BAA-05, in case anyone is searching by town. The rent is USD 9,600/year.
Halba site visit is Thursday. I'll take the visit and check the folder at the store while I'm there.
@Tarek Choueiri can you chase the Saida owner and get a written answer on renewal?
إيه، أنا بتابع مع المالك وبطلب جواب خطّي عن التجديد.
Saida community centre RENT-SAI-06 expires April 10. USD 16,800/year in the draft.
Is that rent for both floors in Saida?
Yes both, including the upstairs room we only use for training.
Can we put March 10 as the deadline for clearing the Saida renewal for signature? That leaves a month on the lease.
D’accord pour le 10 mars, ça nous laisse assez de marge.
Sorry I disappeared, my son has a fever. Catching up now.
On annule la visite à Halba. Le magasin est fermé et personne ne peut nous ouvrir.
Seen, thanks. Saves me a drive.
Finance reopened the reserve file but still has to reconcile it. Budget pack moves again to next Monday.
ok, next Monday works.
Generator finally stopped making that noise. Turns out the door was just rattling.
For the February register, the final rent figures have to be in by the 14th. The portal locks at midnight even on weekends.
Sorry, I meant the 15th not the 14th. Just checked the portal.
Which cost centre should we use for Halba's municipal fee? The rent line has a code but the fee cell is blank.
Saida again: called the owner at lunch, no answer. The written request is still sitting there.
Budget pack sent to finance. Tripoli is still on the draft code in that copy.
Did the Saida reserve go in even though we're waiting for the owner?
Yes, the full USD 16,800 is reserved under EA-2026.
Pour Tripoli, je propose de basculer tout le loyer de la prochaine période sur FA-2026. La ligne est confirmée, et le solde d’EA-2026 doit couvrir Saïda.
tamam, agreed. Full Tripoli rent to FA-2026.
The revised pack is in the folder. Tripoli now shows FA-2026 for the full USD 21,600.
Dans deux semaines, il faut avoir vérifié les codes budgétaires du récapitulatif avec le fichier de la finance.
Leave the code check with me. I can compare both exports.
In case the sheet hangs, it did load for me after refreshing twice.
I put the existing Saida signature-clearance deadline in the Sheet as 10/03 so it sorts with the other dates.
Missing-date rows need to be grouped by end of the week, before we log off Friday. The recap has Halba between two complete rows right now.
I'll group those rows. Halba and that annex in Baalbek are the ones I know about.
بعد ما ردّ مالك مركز صيدا، ولا حتى عالرسالة التانية.
Anyone want coffee?
Grouped the blank-date rows for the recap. The annex is on a separate line from the Baalbek centre.
I can see both lines now. The annex rent is already broken out in the budget.
Morning. The generator is down again so I'm in the front office if anyone's looking.
Is the Jbeil rent still USD 18,600 on the signed annual page?
Yes, same rent. Only the yearly end date changed.
Let's cover Jbeil's next yearly period entirely from WASH-2026. That's the budget line finance confirmed for the health centre.
Fine by me, put the whole Jbeil rent there.
Qui a l’original papier de l’avenant de Jbeil ?
Still no written answer from the Saida owner. Checked the site inbox too.
Tripoli and Jbeil codes both showing in the live sheet now. Finally.
Weekly recap came in. The blank-date section is easy to find now.
Still nothing from Saida. The owner didn't answer when I called this morning either.
Code check done. The recap and the finance file agree for Zahle, Saida, Tripoli and Jbeil. Halba still has that fee cell open.
merci, saw it.
The portal accepted the final figures this morning. Saida's reserve is still in EA-2026.
Saida owner still hasn't replied. The site team knows we're waiting on the written answer.
Thanks all. Logging off before the power does.
